packet.summary: Incident case-g3-fixture: a 7 s call opened with a cloned voice claiming to be Jake (0.0 to 3.0 s, detectors A 0.93 and B-long-context 0.88) and was handed to a real human posing as a lawyer (3.0 to 7.0 s) who asked for a $9,500 wire to a new payee. Jake was texted for confirmation and the transfer was held pending a trusted-contact decision.
